rule: Every referenced entity must exist in the pinned snapshot.
verification: Reference closure and unique entity IDs.

rule: Physical containment is acyclic and within facility boundaries.
verification: PhysicalLocation parent checks.

rule: A cause cannot occur after its effect; causal event graph is acyclic.
verification: Event occurred_at and caused_by checks.

rule: Time intervals have start no later than end.
verification: valid_time, shifts, allocations, queues, authorizations.

rule: Unknown, pending or absent findings must not become numeric observations.
verification: Assertion object and Observation value checks; complex clinical semantics still require review.

rule: A reviewed version must match the target version; approved entities require an approval record.
verification: Exact version checked; reviewer credentials, authority and human authenticity are not established.

rule: Each active individually tracked bed is exclusive over overlapping intervals.
verification: Bed allocation overlap checks in example snapshot.

rule: Capacity/stock counts are nonnegative; availability/confidence fractions are bounded.
verification: Selected numeric bounds.

rule: Sources and relationship endpoints have compatible entity types.
verification: Source type, relation domain/range and selected structural references checked; all attribute target types not yet encoded.

rule: Declared outgoing cardinality holds across reference fields and relationship records together.
verification: Requires canonical edge expansion and complete snapshot scope before enforcement.

rule: Activities execute only when prerequisites, role authority and resources hold.
verification: Requires an executable policy DSL and engine time-state checks.

rule: Patients, capacity, stock and financial components are conserved across transitions.
verification: Requires event reducer, inventory ledger and accounting semantics.

rule: Queue intervals retain censoring and unfinished waits.
verification: Uncensored intervals require exit; statistical handling remains downstream.

rule: Financial values preserve meaning, currency, service setting and billing component.
verification: Required fields and currency shape checked; economic reconciliation remains downstream.

rule: Aggregate findings retain population, period, denominator, suppression and uncertainty.
verification: Entity attributes capture structure; suitability and source period reconciliation require reviewer.

rule: Approved cases remain immutable and encounters retain pinned facts.
verification: Storage/version enforcement and runtime fact retrieval not implemented.

rule: Source licensing and processing rights allow the intended use.
verification: Rights state represented; no automated approval inferred from public accessibility.

rule: Fitted parameters preserve dependencies and use independent validation data.
verification: Metadata represented; statistical checks and holdout leakage detection require acquisition-specific implementation.

rule: Qualitative findings retain attribution and context without stereotype-derived behavior.
verification: Required fields preserve method/context; interpretation needs human review.

rule: A normalized record has raw provenance or a documented limited extraction method.
verification: raw_sha256 required; null only with acquisition_method; actual hash verification belongs to acquisition checks.
